subject: Request: Two-week pilot buffer — SDK deadlock in payments adapter
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Dover <alex.dover@payflow.io>, Priya Shah <priya@payflow.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Two-week pilot buffer — SDK deadlock in payments adapter

Hi Alex / Priya,

Quick update from our side — your engineering team and ours ran into a blocker during the payments adapter integration. The SDK call that should return tokenized card data is intermittently timing out with a 504; the behavior surfaced after your team flipped the new connector routing. Our engs are debugging but this has frozen the demo and the scheduled usage window.

Given the timeline pressure on your pilot, can we offer a two-week buffer on the pilot credits and keep the sandbox environment active while we work through the failure? Specifically we're proposing:
- +14 days on the pilot start/end window
- A small top-up of sandbox credits (we can issue 25k tokens) to allow a follow-up demo once the adapter is stable

I've CC'd Karthik from infra — he can share the initial log snapshot and a short mitigation plan. If this sounds reasonable I can loop in Sales Ops to formalize the extension and credit.

Attachments: integration-log.txt (excerpt), screenshot-error-504.png

Thanks,

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0172

Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 11:02:15 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: Two-week pilot buffer — SDK deadlock in payments adapter

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the heads up.

A couple quick questions so we can triage on our side and confirm internally:
1) Can you share the full stack trace or a minimal replay of the failing request? The screenshot is helpful but we need the request/response pair.
2) If we approve the buffer, will the sandbox credits be consumable only by payflow@payflow.io team members (so we don't overrun)?
3) Any risk that extending the pilot window will change our billing terms? (Just want to be clear for procurement).

If you can send the replay and a short systems note from Karthik we can fast-track this.

On our side Priya will confirm whether we want the top-up or just the window extension.

—
Alex Dover
Head of Integrations | PayFlow
alex.dover@payflow.io

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Two-week pilot buffer — SDK deadlock in payments adapter

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick reply.

Per Karthik (pasted below) we've attached a short replay and the integration-log.txt excerpt so you can see the request/response pairs. The sandbox top-up would be scoped to the PayFlow pilot org/email domain — we will restrict quota to the pilot service account you used. No billing changes: this is a goodwill supplement to keep the proof-of-value intact and does not change commercial terms. Sales Ops will record the extra tokens as a one-time credit against PF-2027-4337.

I've attached pilot-scope-v2.pdf with updated milestones reflecting the +14d window. If that looks ok I'll spin up the Sales Ops ticket and confirm the credit issuance.

Below — note from Karthik with the immediate mitigation we plan to push later today.

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 07:45:12 -0800
Subject: Re: SDK deadlock — initial investigation
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>

We're seeing a stuck connection in the adapter when the downstream tokenization service returns a partial header set; the runtime's connection pool isn't recovering properly and leaves a dangling FD. Replaying the exact failing request shows a 504 at ~13s. Short-term mitigation:
- bump connection timeout from 10s -> 18s for the adapter route (will stop the transient 504s while we patch)
- add a circuit-breaker guard around tokenization calls to fail fast and return structured error to the app
- follow-up patch next week to harden the pool logic and add KV cache eviction to avoid compounding load spikes

I will push the timeout bump to the staging route later today and then run the replay — attaching the replay file.

Karthik
Staff Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 03 Dec 2027 15:24:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: sign-off for pilot buffer + credit issuance (PayFlow)

Marissa — quick internal note to close the loop. The staging replay passed after the timeout bump; risk of recurrence is low but we'll deploy the pool fix early next week. From an engineering standpoint I'm comfortable recommending the +14d buffer and the 25k token sandbox top-up.

If Sales Ops needs a written signoff we should provide:
- approval to issue one-time credit (25k tokens) to deal PF-2027-4337
- confirm restriction to pilot org/service account

Markus / Soojin — can you confirm Sales Ops can apply the credit under the stated constraints? If so Marissa can send final confirmation to PayFlow.

Thanks,
Karthik
